note: Where each included compose file came from (ADR 0147). Vendored verbatim, because Compose's remote include is not available everywhere; check-sources.sh proves each file is unchanged, and with --remote that it still matches its source. Each product's version is set once, by its `variable` in bundle.env.example, which must equal `version`: bumping a product is that line, its vendored file and this entry, checked together.

core.version: ENDORA_CORE_VERSION in .env: the release this checkout is

console.why: Console has no tagged release yet; its README says to pin a sha- build, and this is the build of the pinned commit.

audio.why: v1.0.1 is Audio's latest published release (7 Nov 2026); its hub image is multi-arch, its senders and airplay images amd64.
